title: Lumbar Epidural Steroid Injections
coverage_criteria: Patient must have documented radicular pain (sciatica) radiating below the knee for at least 6 weeks
Diagnosis of herniated disc confirmed by MRI or CT scan within past 6 months
Failed conservative treatment including physical therapy for minimum of 4 weeks
Failed conservative treatment including trial of NSAIDs or other anti-inflammatory medications
Failed conservative treatment including activity modification
Pain level of 5/10 or greater on validated pain scale
No neurological emergency (cauda equina syndrome, progressive motor weakness)
exclusion_criteria: Allergy to local anesthetics or corticosteroids
Previous epidural steroid injection within past 2 weeks
More than 3 injections in a 6-month period
Non-specific low back pain without radiculopathy
Injections performed more frequently than every 2 weeks
required_documentation: Clinical notes documenting duration and nature of symptoms
Results of MRI or CT scan showing disc herniation
Documentation of failed conservative treatments with dates
Physical examination findings including neurological assessment
